name: EEE
fix_description: In swap (0x022c0d9f), the function makes an external callback before updating reserves, allowing the attacker to re-enter and perform mint/burn/swap loops within a single transaction. Add nonReentrant modifier or update reserves before making external calls (CEI pattern).
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step price/manipulation-style exploit using a flash swap, direct LP token transfers, repeated router swaps, and final settlement, so it requires understanding the protocol-specific LP/router behavior rather than just spotting a trivial bug. The exploit flow is still fairly short and the PoC is compact, so it is not hard, but it is more involved than a simple single-call access control or reentrancy case.
